descripcion: Pantalla dividida en vertical 50/50 con una línea blanca fina al centro; ambas mitades son fotos reales a sangre de la misma persona con el producto, oscurecidas arriba con un degradado negro. Arriba de cada mitad va un encabezado de tiempo gigante en amarillo («Día 1» / «Día 30») con una línea pequeña debajo y, bajo él, 4 cajas-etiqueta apiladas: a la izquierda blancas con borde amarillo, a la derecha rellenas de amarillo (el estado escalado). A la izquierda, un primer plano de manos sosteniendo el producto frente a la cara; a la derecha, un contrapicado dinámico del producto en acción. Un sello circular blanco de garantía cierra en la esquina inferior derecha. No es problema contra solución: es una escalada (el Día 1 ya es bueno, el Día 30 es épico), aspiracional y con un toque de humor. Detiene muy bien el scroll.
ad_format: Day 1 vs Day 30 Split-Screen Escalation Ad
reference_style: Bold, aspirational split-screen ad made of two real full-bleed photos of the same person with the product, darkened at the top, with giant yellow time headers and two stacks of four label boxes (outlined on the left, filled on the right) and a white circular guarantee seal

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two giant yellow time headers, which set up the comparison. 2) The two photos, close-up on the left and dynamic action on the right. 3) The two stacks of label boxes, read left then right, where the filled right boxes signal the level-up. 4) The guarantee seal in the lower-right corner. 5) The small lines under the time headers.
art_direction.composition_style: Vertical 50/50 split across the whole canvas, divided by a thin white line at exactly 50% of the width. Each half is a full-bleed photo with its own text stack in the upper part, centered on that half: time header, small line, then four stacked label boxes. The product lives in the lower half of each photo: held up to the camera in the left half, in action and very close to the lens in the right half. The guarantee seal overlaps the lower-right corner of the right photo.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Divider: full height at 50% of the width, about 0.4% of the canvas wide. Time headers: centered on each half (at about 25% and 75% of the width), from about 5% to 11.5% of the canvas height. Small lines: centered under each header, at about 12.5-15% of the height. Label boxes: four per half, left boxes from about 9% to 41% of the width, right boxes from about 59% to 91%; rows at about 18-23.5%, 24.5-30%, 31-36.5% and 37.5-43% of the height (each about 5.5% tall with about 1% gaps), corner radius about 0.8% of the canvas. Left photo: the product, held in both hands, occupies about 5-42% of the width and 45-100% of the height, with the person's face partly visible behind it on the right side of that half. Right photo: the product, on the person's limb or body, occupies about 55-85% of the width and 60-100% of the height, very close to the lens. Guarantee seal: circle about 21% of the canvas width in diameter, centered at about 88.5% of the width and 88% of the height, so it almost touches the right and bottom edges (about 1% margin).
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Two real, candid-looking outdoor photos with natural daylight, rich contrast and a slightly cinematic grade (deep shadows, saturated colors in the urban or activity setting). Each half is darkened by a black gradient at the top (about 85% opacity at the top edge, fading to transparent at about 45-50% of the height) so the yellow and white graphics read clearly. Left photo: eye-level close-up with shallow depth of field, the product sharp and the face softly blurred behind it. Right photo: wide-angle worm's-eye view from very low, the product sharp in the foreground with dynamic perspective and the person and sky behind. Boxes, headers and seal are flat graphics; the seal has a soft drop shadow.

layout_summary: Square canvas split vertically in two equal halves by a thin white line. Left half: a full-bleed real photo of a person holding the user's product up in both hands in front of their face, close to the camera, outdoors; at the top, over a black gradient, a giant yellow condensed uppercase time header ('Day 1' idea), a small yellow line under it and four stacked rectangular label boxes, white with a yellow border and black condensed uppercase text. Right half: a full-bleed real photo from a very low angle of the same person in a dynamic action wearing or using the product, which looms large in the foreground; at the top, the same structure with a later time header ('Day 30' idea), the same small line and four stacked label boxes filled in solid yellow with black text. A white circular seal with a black guarantee text overlaps the lower-right corner.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left 50% of the canvas, full height, edge to edge
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the first moment with the product: already exciting from day one
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Real-looking candid photo of a person matching the target audience holding the user's product up with both hands in front of their face, close to the camera, looking at it, in the setting where the product is used (street court, gym, outdoors, home). Eye-level close-up with shallow depth of field. Darken the top with a black gradient for the texts.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right 50% of the canvas, full height, edge to edge
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the escalated, epic result after using the product for a while
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Real-looking photo of the same person, now in a dynamic peak moment of use (kicking, running, jumping, showing off, performing) with the product worn or used and very close to the lens, shot from a very low worm's-eye angle with wide-angle perspective, sky or setting behind. Darken the top with a black gradient for the texts.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left half: held in both hands at about 5-42% of the canvas width and 45-100% of the height. Right half: worn or used, in the foreground at about 55-85% of the width and 60-100% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Keeps the product as the hero of both moments
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, material, label, logo and colors) in both halves, sharply in focus. Never cover it with the label boxes.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full height at exactly 50% of the canvas width, about 0.4% of the canvas wide
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Straight solid white line, flat, with no badge or icon on it.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left half, from about 9% to 41% of the canvas width, rows at about 18-23.5%, 24.5-30%, 31-36.5% and 37.5-43% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Lists the immediate wins of the first moment
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Four identical rectangles with slightly rounded corners (about 0.8% of the canvas), white fill and a yellow border about 0.5% of the canvas thick, each holding one centered line of text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right half, from about 59% to 91% of the canvas width, same rows as the left boxes
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Lists the escalated wins; the solid fill signals the level-up
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Four identical rectangles with the same size and radius as the left boxes, solid warm yellow fill with a thin lighter yellow edge, each holding one centered line of text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower-right corner, overlapping the right photo, about 21% of the canvas width in diameter, centered at about 88.5% of the width and 88% of the height, almost touching the right and bottom edges

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid white circle with a soft drop shadow, holding three stacked lines of black condensed text: the guarantee period large on top and two smaller lines below. Write the user's real guarantee.

mandatory_visual_elements: Vertical 50/50 split with a thin white divider
Two full-bleed real photos of the same person with the product, darkened at the top by a black gradient
Left photo: product held in both hands in front of the face, close-up
Right photo: low-angle dynamic action shot with the product in the foreground
Giant yellow time header and small yellow line at the top of each half
Four outlined white label boxes on the left and four filled yellow label boxes on the right
White circular guarantee seal in the lower-right corner
forbidden_additions: Price, discount, offer or shipping badge
Main headline band or subheadline above the split
Desaturated or 'problem' grade on the left half
More than two panels or a horizontal split
More than 4 label boxes per half
notas_paleta: Fotos reales con colores naturales y contrastados del contexto de uso, oscurecidas arriba con un degradado negro. Encabezados de tiempo y líneas de apoyo en amarillo cálido y saturado (o en el acento de la marca si es luminoso y contrasta sobre negro). Cajas de la izquierda blancas con borde amarillo y texto negro; cajas de la derecha rellenas del mismo amarillo con texto negro. Divisor y sello en blanco con texto negro. El producto conserva sus colores reales; la ropa del set puede llevar colores de la marca.
